sentences.text: Arvind Painkra vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 15 February, 2024
High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur

Order Sheet
 Cra No.2225 of 2023

Arvind Painkra S/o Badan Singh Painkra Aged About 30 Years
 R/o Gangapur, Ambikapur, District Surguja, C.G.
 ---- Appellant
 Versus
 State of Chhattisgarh Through Mahila Thana, Ambikapur, District Surguja,
 Chhattisgarh.

---- Respondent
15.02.2024 Shri Anurag Singh, Advocate for the appellant.
Shri B.D. Guru, Addl.
Advocate General for the State.
Heard on I.A. No. 01 of 2023, which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.

The appellant stands convicted and sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.5000/- u/s 376(2)(n) IPC with default stipulation, as ordered on 24.11.2023 by the Additional Sessions Judge FTC Ambikapur, District Surguja, in Sessions Trial No.87/2019.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge FTC Ambikapur, District Surguja
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant would submit that the appellant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the offence.

The prosecutrix is aged about 26 years and have voluntarily and consensually made physical relation with the appellant and it is only when the appellant refused to marry with the prosecutrix, a report has been lodged.
During trial he was on bail and have not misused the liberty granted by the trial court.
Therefore, he may be released on bail after suspending his jail sentence awarded by the trial Court.
On the other hand the counsel for the State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.

Considering the submissions made by the counsel for the parties, considering the nature of allegations; the fact that the appellant was on bail during trial and also considering the fact that appeal is of the year, 2023 and there is no likelihood of early final hearing of the appeal, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case in which the substantive jail sentence imposed on the appellant can be suspended and he can be enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, I.A. No.01/2023 is allowed.

It is directed that substantive jail sentence imposed on the accused/appellant shall remain suspended during pendency of this criminal appeal and he shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety for the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 05.04.2024 and thereafter before the concerned trial Court on a date to be fixed by the Registry and thereafter on all such subsequent dates as would be given by that Court till final disposal of this appeal.
